source_name: Planning applications: called-in decisions and recovered appeals
publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government / Planning Casework Unit
source_type: official GOV.UK collection of Secretary of State called-in decisions and recovered appeals
license_and_attribution: Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated; attribute public sector information to GOV.UK / MHCLG / Planning Casework Unit.
coverage_years: Relevant queried records span 2014-2026 on live GOV.UK pages; the collection says pre-2018 decisions are also available through National Archives routes.
geographic_scope: England; candidates filtered to sites in Greater London.
reliability: strong for administrative decision existence, date, source URL, and case reference; weaker for older collection-log-only records where full PDFs are no longer linked.
required_caveats: Secretary of State called-in and recovered appeal decisions are planning-process milestones only. They do not evidence construction start, completion, occupation, opening, built design quality, or effects.
ingestion_recommendation: Ingest candidates with live decision pages first. For collection-log-only 2014 items, retrieve archived/FOI decision letters before promoting to the main corpus.

source_name: HS2 Phase One Planning Forum planning appeal decisions
publisher: High Speed Two (HS2) Limited / Planning Inspectorate / GOV.UK
source_type: official GOV.UK page for Schedule 17 appeal decision notices
license_and_attribution: GOV.UK page under OGL v3.0 except where otherwise stated; decision PDFs should be checked for document-specific restrictions.
coverage_years: Published 2020, updated through 2024, with HS2 Phase One appeal documents.
geographic_scope: HS2 Phase One route; candidates filtered to London borough entries such as Camden and Hillingdon.
reliability: usable with caveats for administrative Schedule 17 appeal milestones; document-level effective dates need PDF extraction for production use.
required_caveats: Schedule 17 appeal decisions are administrative route/works-control milestones, not evidence of construction, route use, completion, or impact outcomes.
ingestion_recommendation: Use as a supporting planning-admin source after extracting each decision PDF date and exact works-location description.

source_type: official Planning Inspectorate appeal case/document portal
license_and_attribution: Official public-sector appeal decision PDFs; reuse should be checked against GOV.UK/OGL terms and any document-specific restrictions before redistribution.
coverage_years: Queried examples include 2024-2025 appeal decisions; portal coverage varies by appeal type and migration state.
geographic_scope: England; candidates filtered to London addresses.
reliability: strong for individual appeal decision date, address, outcome, and reference when PDF is directly accessible.
required_caveats: Ordinary appeal decisions are administrative milestones, often minor or condition-specific, and should not be over-weighted as major city-change evidence unless linked to a material architectural or heritage change.
ingestion_recommendation: Use selectively for architecture-related decisions with clear site coordinates and proposal text; retain direct PDF URL and appeal reference.
